# Lumen snapshot

This bounded snapshot includes LumenTokens and LumenUI with a later
Sources/LumenUI/LumenSettings.swift implementation providing the settings-window
scaffold. This is a derived snapshot, not a single upstream release. AIRS
maintains the reduced two-product manifest. Public-source cleanup neutralizes
personal review comments and preview sample labels without changing component
behavior. Exact import identities remain in private provenance records.
Catalog, examples, tests, research captures and development records are excluded.

Lumen and AIRS share the same owner. On 2026-10-19 the owner confirmed
authorship of both and authorized including Lumen with AIRS for distribution.
On 2026-10-22 the owner licensed this bundled snapshot under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
Third-party platform material retains its applicable terms; see
[third-party notices](../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
